author: TheAdventureMan
body: its been like 1 years since i played this server. i admit i used antiknockback/aimbot a long time ago, but i can garuntee u it will never happen again. i had just got those two mods and got super carried away at the time, thinking i was cool and sneaky and all that crap, but i keep thinking back to wen i played this server and it was my faverite and i wish i never used the mods at all. i really want back on, yal super cool, and i guess id understand if ur all still mad, but if u were really really nice and did let be on u would never have any probloms with me at all, i dont currently own any mods because of how mad i was at myself for getting banned. also, 1 years, thats a pretty long time to be banned, but watever, ur call.......pls
